description: Fleet timer manifest — every user timer must have an entry with a named reason. CI validates live timers against this manifest.

agent-cron-0509-daily-market-signal.time.reason: Daily 0509 market signal cron — true calendar job at 08:15 IST

agent-governor-orphan-watchdog.timer.reason: 5-min all-agents orphan janitor — reaps marked descendants whose supervisor is gone; 5-min bounds detection

agent-scheduler-drift.timer.reason: Daily scheduler drift check — detects drift between declared and actual timer state; runs at 03:00 IST

daily-digest.timer.reason: 9 AM IST daily digest push — live Pi-era data only (merged PRs, failed units, Prometheus alerts, seat health, disk %)

evening-highlights-digest.timer.reason: 9 PM IST evening highlights digest push (vacation window through 2026-09-08) — second sanctioned digest slot, wins-only; silence if nothing worth saying

escalation-daily-sweep.timer.reason: Daily dead-man floor for SENIOR-AUDITOR escalation layer — bounds max time-to-audit at 24h for failures with no dedicated tripwire

escalation-drain.timer.reason: Hourly bounded-file maintainer for NISH-ESCALATIONS.md and alert-repair packet dir (fleet-ops#2677 + #2773) — accumulation is structural (every CAP-REACHED + every Alertmanager webhook appends), so hourly bounds the live file to roughly one cycle's worth of growth; daily-sweep is the dead-man floor if the drain dies

fleet-aeo-probe.timer.reason: Weekly AEO visibility probe — measurement window is weekly; must land before Weekly Fleet Review (Sun 04:30 IST)

fleet-asset-census.timer.reason: Weekly VPS asset census — runs before Weekly Fleet Review so Pi review starts from enumerated, guarded surface

fleet-bare-metal-rebuild-drill.timer.reason: Weekly bare-metal rebuild drill — manifest completeness invariant is not an event signal; weekly container proof catches drift

fleet-blind-audit.timer.reason: Daily blind audit floor — unknown unknowns have no event to subscribe to; daily calendar floor is the only correct primary trigger

fleet-completion-canary.timer.reason: 15-min hop-clock canary — PathChanged cannot notice 'nothing happened'; this timer detects stalled alert-repair chains within one tick of the tightest clock

fleet-console-pi.timer.reason: Fleet Console (Pi) page refresh — GitHub PR/CI state drifts continuously; 12-min cadence keeps page current inside API budget. CONVERTING TO PATH UNIT

fleet-deploy-check.timer.reason: Merge-to-live deploy check — TOP GEAR: merged-but-not-live latency bound. CONVERTING TO PATH UNIT on state file changes

fleet-heartbeat.timer.reason: Orchestrator continuity across interactive-session restarts — event notifications die with sessions; this timer survives every session exit

fleet-landing-watch.timer.reason: Fleet landing watch — Nish 2026-09-04 while away; every 6h sanity pass

fleet-metrics-export.timer.reason: Fleet Prometheus metrics export — 5-min cadence for metrics freshness; piggybacks git-mirror-update and waste-ledger. Metrics are an aggregate snapshot with no single upstream event; 5-min cadence is the scrape interval floor

fleet-resilience-drill.timer.reason: Daily four-plane resilience drill — each plane's failure is silent without periodic proof; daily at 05:47 IST off heartbeat cluster

fleet-restore-drill.timer.reason: 6h control-plane restore drill — rebuild story is a continuity invariant with no event signal; 6h catches stale backup within one waking window

gap-closure-drill-stub-mask.timer.reason: Throwaway yearly timer for gap-closure mask-detection drills — never enabled; the drill runtime-masks then unmasks it. Named so timer-manifest shape lock does not fail on the repo file.

fleet-weekly-fleet-review.timer.reason: Weekly Fleet Review (WFR) — mandated weekly senior review per WBR/kaizen pattern; Sun 04:30 IST post-maintenance chain

fleet-baseline-delta.timer.reason: Weekly baseline-delta strangeness pre-pass (fleet-ops#1151) — unknown-unknown metric strangeness has no event to subscribe to; fires Sun 04:00 IST, 30 min before the 04:30 WFR whose input dir it writes (after quiesce 03:15 / vps-weekly-update 03:30)

fleet2-digest.timer.reason: DEPRECATED: fleet2 legacy digest timer — to be removed per fleet-ops simplification

fleet2-dispatch.timer.reason: DEPRECATED: fleet2 legacy dispatch timer — to be removed per fleet-ops simplification

fleet2-events.timer.reason: DEPRECATED: fleet2 legacy events timer — to be removed per fleet-ops simplification

gh-webhook-canary-deadman.timer.reason: GitHub push-channel dead-man's switch — every 5 min checks the synthetic canary's last-green metric and pages if missing/stale > 15 min (fleet-ops#1464).

gh-webhook-canary.timer.reason: GitHub push-channel synthetic canary — every 5 min posts a synthetic issues/labeled/agent-ready event through the local receiver and bumps the last-green metric (fleet-ops#1464).

intake-reconcile.timer.reason: 30-min backstop for intake reconciler — path unit handles synchronous file-change trips; this timer catches missed mtime bumps or masked path units

interactive-session-reap.timer.reason: Hourly stale-interactive-session reaper — idle age is a clock fact, not an event; hourly is proportionate to measured 8h idle threshold

nish-memory-curator.timer.reason: 5-min shared-memory curation — compiles verified Nish captures from vault; could be event-driven on vault changes but vault churn is high

opus-heartbeat.timer.reason: Opus 5 fleet heartbeat — snapshot gather + duty-officer judge every 30 min at :00/:30; off-peak cadence for fleet snapshot

opus-heartbeat-thorough.timer.reason: 6-hourly thorough duty-officer pass — reassess 2026-09-08; four passes per day for deep tier until return

pi-escalation-audit.timer.reason: Hourly senior escalation panel intake — escalations are rare and network-bound; hourly floor keeps time-to-panel under an hour

pi-transport-check.timer.reason: Pi transport integrity fallback heartbeat — 30-min backstop for .path unit that can miss replace-by-rename or be inactive across restarts

quality-research-weekly.timer.reason: Weekly quality>speed>efficiency research sweep — outside world changes weekly; Sunday 03:00 IST off-peak delta sweep

siterep-deploy.timer.reason: DISABLED: siterep.net autonomous deploy drift tick — deliberately NOT installed per packet p51; kept for reference

siterep-live-canary.timer.reason: Hourly siterep.net live canary (T3 deep tier) — chromium+firefox layout smoke + synthetic monitor; hourly per three-tier monitoring cadence

siterep-pr-conflict-watchdog.timer.reason: PR conflict watchdog for siterep.net — detects merge conflicts on open PRs

siterep-uptime.timer.reason: 2-min uptime probe for siterep.net (T1) — decisive HTTP 200 + TLS + title marker; Persistent=false so missed probes don't stack on boot

tinystudio-live-site-check.timer.reason: Nightly live-site check for tinystudio.in — soft-404, headings, tap targets, social preview, promptly support

vault-conflict-resolver.timer.reason: 10-min Syncthing conflict resolver — *.sync-conflict-* files freeze every vault writer; 10-min matches resolver's DISPATCH_COOLDOWN_SEC. CONVERTING TO PATH UNIT

vault-knowledge-format.timer.reason: Daily vault knowledge-format lint — daily floor catches drift in 03 Knowledge shape before monthly red-team review

vps-maintenance-deadman.timer.reason: Fail-safe resume if maintenance window never cleared pause flag — Tue 23:09 IST dead-man

fleet-rulebook-redteam.timer.reason: Monthly rulebook red-team floor — heading-growth bonus fires via heartbeat; calendar floor catches a month the box was down

fleet-truth-staleness-check.timer.reason: Weekly truth staleness checker — cross-checks standing docs against live state (fleet-ops#1137). Docs rot slowly; weekly cadence catches stale paths, units, and issue refs.

fleet-worktree-reaper.timer.reason: Daily orphan agent-worktree GC (fleet-ops#2227 + #2637) — Mode A: claim/issue-<N> + merged PR. Mode B: issue-<short>-<N> PATH + dispatch-ledger terminal entry + HEAD on origin. Either mode's full gate chain must pass (no live worker, clean tree, work preserved on origin). Catches worker churn within one waking window; fail-safe (dry-run capable, gh failure skips repo, missing ledger fails closed), cheap (git + one gh pr list per repo + one git ls-remote per Mode B candidate).

vps-maintenance-quiesce.timer.reason: Weekly maintenance quiesce (T-15) — stops NEW work only; Sun 03:15 IST before vps-weekly-update

vps-weekly-update.timer.reason: Weekly VPS full-stack update — apt, npm globals, self-updaters, docker; Sun 03:30 IST after 15-min quiesce drain

vps-post-reboot-verify.timer.reason: Re-verify agent stack ~30 min after expected reboot (fleet-ops#1160) — catches delayed tailscale recovery or failed unit recovery that the first vps-post-reboot-verify.service missed; Persistent=true so it survives a reboot during the maintenance window

grok-token-refresh.timer.reason: Headless OAuth refresh of SuperGrok xai-oauth seat — access token lifetime is 6h; 4h cadence keeps ~/.pi/agent/auth.json fresh so an idle prepaid seat does not wake into a 401 (fleet-ops#41).

fleet-seat-comeback-release.timer.reason: 15-min ACTIVE come-back release (fleet-ops#2421): a walled seat whose wall clock (bench_until ?? usable_at) has passed is re-probed with a 1-token reply-OK dispatch and a provably-usable seat is unwalled (healthy observation written to the ledger, priming fleet-seat-recovery). Loud stalled check: expired walls remain with zero releases -> exit 1 + fleet_seat_comeback_release_stalled=1
